reviews.author: Abhi Satapathy
reviews.comment: Really loved the experience at The Monarch’s Mug! ☕✨ The ambience is cozy and peaceful, perfect for spending some quality time with friends. The food and drinks were really good, and the service was friendly too. Overall, a nice place to chill, relax and enjoy some good food. Definitely worth visiting! ❤️

reviews.author: Divyarani Parhi
reviews.comment: This was my second time visiting Monarch's Mug, and it is really a nice place to hang out with friends. The food and drinks were good, and the ambience was also very pleasant and relaxing. Overall, it’s a great spot to chill, enjoy good food, and spend quality time. I would definitely suggest visiting and enjoying the experience.

reviews.author: Krishnaa Sahoo
reviews.comment: One of the best cafes have ever visited. Amazing experience, delicious food. I visit here almost everyday and tbh never got disappointed with their service. Each and every staff in the cafe are really sweet to us, do visit. A great place to hangout with your friends 💖✨

reviews.author: Gayatree Dash
reviews.comment: The cafe is very nice.. Good vibe.. Great crowd.. Very peaceful, clean and photogenic. Great for celebrations and office lunch.. Very nice rooftop set up.. Instagram friendly vibe.. Food is also great and affordable price. Like it very much.. Would reccomend my family and friends to visit.

reviews.author: Toufik Hasan
reviews.comment: The Monarch’s Mug is an amazing place to relax and enjoy great food and coffee. The atmosphere is warm, cozy, and perfect for hanging out with friends or even working for a while. The food quality is excellent, everything tastes fresh and flavorful.

reviews.author: Suchismita Nayak
reviews.comment: The food was very delicious. The service was exceptionally good and the place is also very budget friendly. I will definitely recommend this place. I really like environment and vibe.

reviews.author: Satyajit Sahoo
reviews.comment: Here the tea was really good, and also the foods are taste good... here the service is good and the staffs were very friendly. It is a must visit place, I would recommend this cafe.

reviews.author: Hemanta Saha
reviews.comment: The food was absolutely fantastic, bursting with flavor! 🤤 The atmosphere is truly wonderful and inviting. 😍 The service was okay. ✨

reviews.author: Monalisha Haripal
reviews.comment: This place is great for hanging out with friends. We really enjoyed our time here. It has such warm and beautiful vibes. I would honestly suggest everyone visit at least once — and yes, it’s perfect for clicking amazing pictures too😁😁

reviews.author: Abhay Ojha
reviews.comment: Had a wonderful experience at The Monarch’s Mug! The food was delicious and freshly prepared, and the presentation was great. The service was quick and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere of the café is cozy and peaceful.

reviews.author: Asim Amitav Panda
reviews.comment: Great and classy place. Has a great vibe. Very tasty food and the best thing is the prices are on the cheaper side. The service and crowd management could be better. But yet not so disappointed. Evening well spent. Do drop a visit.
